summary.text: David Gottfried is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 40B, which he has represented since March 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Allen Shen. He works as a legal consultant.

paragraphs.text: David Gottfried lives in Shoreview, Minnesota.

Ballotpedia says he earned a bachelor's degree from St. Olaf College and a graduate degree from the Humphrey School of Public Affairs at the University of Minnesota, and that his career includes work as a pro bono specialist.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations with the Lawyers' Committee for Civil Rights Under Law and the Volunteer Lawyers Network.
Gottfried defeated Paul Wikstrom in the special general election for District 40B on March 11, 2025, and assumed office on March 17, 2025.
His committee assignments include Agriculture Finance and Policy, Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy, and Education Policy.
